title: J065--Mobile MRI Trailer Preventive Maintenance and Repairs
agency_path: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.261-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 21 (36C261)
detail_text: DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS NETWORK CONTRACTING OFFICE 21 (NCO 21) Description: THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE FOR A REQUEST FOR QUOTE (RFQ). VA Pacific Islands Health Care System has an immediate need for Mobile MRI Trailer Preventive Maintenance and Repairs. Solicitation Number 36C26126Q0604 for this effort will be posted to SAM.GOV (https://sam.gov) on or about April 27, 2026. This solicitation will contain all necessary specifications and information necessary to quote the project. See solicitation for when questions must be submitted. Quotes are tentatively scheduled to be due on Monday, May 18, 2026 (see solicitation when available for specific time/date). Point of Contact: Tim Smith, Contract Specialist, Timothy.smith9de3@va.gov. Questions regarding this notice may be submitted via e-mail to Timothy.smith9de3@va.gov.
